prompt: Between 2016 and 2024, which badminton player won an Olympic medal (any color) in women's singles at the third-youngest age?
answer: **An Se-young of South Korea** won an Olympic women’s singles medal at the third-youngest age among the 2016–2024 Games medalists. She was **22 years and 182 days old** when she won gold at Paris 2024.
